Services

What we do

  • Lock changes & rekeying

    Moved in, lost a key or ended a tenancy. We make sure old keys stop working.

  • Smart & digital locks

    Keypad, fingerprint and app locks, supplied and fitted, or set up one you already have.

  • Sliding & glass doors

    Sliding door locks, aluminium door locks and handles that line up and lock properly.

  • Repairs & adjustments

    Stiff, sticking or broken locks, and doors that won't latch or lock.

  • Lockouts

    Locked out of your home or unit. We get you back in, without damage wherever possible.

  • Business locks

    Shopfront and office locks, master key systems and access control.
